title: Magnetic field direction
description: Essential: The response must state that the magnetic field is directed into the plane of the paper (or perpendicular inward).

title: Minimum magnetic induction
description: Essential: The final answer for B_m must be correctly derived as B_m = m v_0 / (q h).

title: Radius-force relationship
description: Important: The student must apply Newton's second law with the Lorentz force to relate radius, mass, velocity, charge, and field: q v_0 B = m v_0^2 / R.

title: Geometry for minimum B
description: Important: For part (1), the reasoning must connect the condition that the particle exits at the y-axis to the requirement that the circular path's radius R equals h.

title: Radius for half field
description: Important: For part (2), the student must correctly compute the new radius R' = 2h when B = B_m/2.

title: Exit angle calculation
description: Essential: The final answer for the exit angle α must be π/6 (or 30°).

title: Vertical distance calculation
description: Essential: The final answer for the distance y must be (2 - √3)h.

title: Trigonometric geometry
description: Important: For part (2), the solution must use correct right-triangle or chord geometry (e.g., sin α = h/R') to find the angle and then the vertical displacement.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the magnetic field direction is stated incorrectly (e.g., out of the page) or if the force direction rule is misapplied.

title: Algebraic or unit mistake
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the relationship R = m v / (q B) is inverted (e.g., R = q B / (m v)) or if units are inconsistent in final expressions.
